lines.text: This is the Point Mersey lighthouse, and this is Marek, its last keeper.
lines.caps: This is the *Point Mersey lighthouse, | and this is *Marek, | its last keeper.

lines.text: For thirty years, his light met every ship at the door of the dark.
lines.caps: For thirty years, | his light met every ship | at the door of the *dark.

lines.text: But ships have GPS now. So one night, Marek asks the obvious question.
lines.caps: But ships have *GPS now. | So one night, Marek asks | the obvious *question.

lines.text: He flips the switch. The beam dies. And the sea doesn't even notice.
lines.caps: He flips the *switch. | The beam *dies. | And the sea doesn't even *notice.

lines.text: Then the stars start going out. One. By. One.
lines.caps: Then the stars start *going out. | One. By. One.

lines.text: Not clouds. Not fog. The dark is eating the sky, starting from the edges.
lines.caps: Not *clouds. Not *fog. | The dark is *eating the sky, | starting from the *edges.

lines.text: Marek runs up one hundred and eight steps.
lines.caps: Marek runs up | one hundred and *eight steps.

lines.text: His hands shake. The first match breaks. The second one bends.
lines.caps: His hands *shake. | The first match *breaks. | The second one *bends.

lines.text: The third one catches, and the beam punches a hole in the dark.
lines.caps: The third one *catches, | and the beam *punches a hole | in the *dark.

lines.text: And the sky lights back up. Star by star. Like someone forgave him.
lines.caps: And the sky lights *back up. | Star by *star. | Like someone *forgave him.

lines.text: Nobody ever found out what that dark was.
lines.caps: Nobody ever found out | what that dark *was.

lines.text: But every keeper since leaves the lamp burning one extra minute. Just in case.

lines.text: Some jobs matter for reasons nobody writes down.
